tabs.headline: Music for games
tabs.body: I write music in my free time and I'd love to compose for video games: themes, short cues, and background tracks.

tabs.label: Levels
tabs.headline: Level design
tabs.body: In Unity projects like Level and The Arena, I design puzzles and fights that teach the mechanics as you play.

tabs.label: Azure
tabs.headline: Technical Lead · Microsoft Azure
tabs.body: At Microsoft in Vancouver, I lead automation and SoC validation across four projects: ARM firmware in SystemC/C/C++, FPGA and silicon test automation in Python and C++, and Azure DevOps (CLI, ADO, REST, AAD, Artifacts). I lead a team of four using Scrum and standardize pipelines across orgs.
